Unblocked: task 619 phase 8 can now finish its downstream test-corpus repairs and merge the migration with the barrel green.

memory_candidates.content: In Lean 4, `open A.B.C` does NOT activate scoped notations declared in parent namespace A.B - only those in A.B.C itself. A file relying on `open Cslib.Logic.PL` cannot see `Cslib.Logic`-scoped notations from Operators.lean; it needs an explicit `open Cslib.Logic`.

Scoped notations that collide exactly (token+precedence+associativity) with core notations make every use parse as a two-way choice node; nested chains then cost exponential elaborator backtracking that no heartbeat budget bounds, because per-alternative deterministic-timeout exceptions are swallowed by `observing` in choice elaboration. Fix pattern: offset the scoped precedence by +1 from core (e.g. infixr:31 vs core 30), as HasAnd already did (36 vs 35).
